## Definition
A DARPA initiative aimed at enabling on-demand manufacturing of complex single-crystal materials through nanoscale precise control, bridging the gap between AI-driven material design and production. This program could provide the material foundation for next-generation microsystems, potentially enabling novel substrates or components for TCC/iNEST hardware.
